expected_answer: Connection pooling avoids connection overhead using pool sizes and max overflow. Read replicas offload queries, while health probes detect database failure and trigger circuit breaking with exponential backoff.

Strong consistency guarantees all nodes see identical data immediately via synchronous replication or quorum consensus. Eventual consistency allows temporary divergence, guaranteeing convergence over time.

Durable checkpointing persists state dictionaries into a relational database after each node transition, tied to a unique thread_id. If a worker process fails, execution resumes from the latest checkpoint.
